description: This file defines an Angular component 'TimelineComponent' for displaying and interacting with a trace timeline, including video playback, trace selection, and timestamp navigation.

classes.name: TimelineComponent
classes.description: An Angular component managing the display and interaction of a timeline with trace data, including video, trace selection, and timestamp navigation.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up video URL if available, and updates timestamp inputs.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Emits the initial height of the collapsed timeline for layout adjustments.

methods.name: getVideoCurrentTime
methods.description: Returns the current video playback time corresponding to the trace position.

methods.name: onTracePositionUpdate
methods.description: Handles trace position updates by syncing timestamp inputs.

methods.name: toggleExpand
methods.description: Toggles the expansion state of the timeline view.

methods.name: updatePosition
methods.description: Updates the trace position in the timeline data.

methods.name: usingRealtime
methods.description: Checks if the timeline is using real time timestamps.

methods.name: updateSeekTimestamp
methods.description: Sets a new seek timestamp and updates timestamp inputs.

methods.name: updateTimeInputValuesToCurrentTimestamp
methods.description: Synchronizes timestamp input fields with the current trace position.

methods.name: isOptionDisabled
methods.description: Determines if a trace type option should be disabled based on selection limits.

methods.name: onTraceSelectionClosed
methods.description: Handles the closing of trace selection dropdown, updating selected traces.

methods.name: applyNewTraceSelection
methods.description: Applies the current trace selections from the form.

methods.name: handleKeyboardEvent
methods.description: Handles keyboard events for trace navigation.

methods.name: hasPrevEntry
methods.description: Checks if there is a previous trace entry available.

methods.name: hasNextEntry
methods.description: Checks if there is a next trace entry available.

methods.name: moveToPreviousEntry
methods.description: Moves the trace position to the previous entry.

methods.name: moveToNextEntry
methods.description: Moves the trace position to the next entry.

methods.name: humanElapsedTimeInputChange
methods.description: Parses and applies user input for human-readable elapsed time.

methods.name: humanRealTimeInputChanged
methods.description: Parses and applies user input for human-readable real time.

methods.name: nanosecondsInputTimeChange
methods.description: Parses and applies user input for nanosecond timestamp.
